xtra

xtra provides a growing collection of extra utility functions for R. It currently includes:

  • read_excel_multi_headers() reads Excel files with multiple header rows and merged cells.
  • save_plot() saves any plot to disk.
  • docx_add_img() adds images with optional captioning to Word documents.

Installation

You can install the development version of xtra from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("NourEdinDarwish/xtra")
